get.description: get the status of server.

post.description: Update password for an authenticated user
Send OTP to user email for password reset
Authenticate user and set access and refresh tokens as HttpOnly cookies
Clear access_token and refresh_token HttpOnly cookies

get.description: Returns 200 OK and verification status if the user has a valid access token

post.description: Generates and sends an OTP to the authenticated user's email
Verify the authenticated user's email using an OTP

Exchange the refresh_token cookie (or request body) for a new access token.

parameters.description: Refresh Request (optional if refresh_token cookie is set)
parameters.name: request

post.description: Reset password using an OTP and email
Register a new user and receive access and refresh tokens via HttpOnly cookies

400.description: Email already taken or invalid input

get.description: Handle OAuth provider callback, verify CSRF state, and return tokens as cookies.

Returns the authorization URL for a specific provider (google, github).
The frontend should redirect the user to the returned auth_url.
Returns all organizations the authenticated user belongs to

post.description: Create a new organization. The caller becomes the owner.

get.description: Returns the details of a specific organization

put.description: Update the name and description of an organization. Requires Admin or Owner role.

delete.description: Permanently delete an organization. Only the Owner can do this.

get.description: Returns paginated audit activity records for an organization. Restricted to Org Admins and Owners.
get.summary: List and filter organization audit logs

get.description: Returns all members of an organization. Requires membership.

post.description: Invite a registered user to join the organization. Requires Admin or Owner role.

delete.description: Remove a member from the organization. Requires Admin or Owner.

put.description: Change a member's role within the organization. Requires Admin or Owner.

get.description: Returns all projects within the given organization

post.description: Create a database sync project inside an organization

get.description: Returns project details including its configured database connections

put.description: Update project name, description, or environment

delete.description: Permanently delete a project and all its database connection configurations

get.description: List all database connections for a project

post.description: Register a database connection (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite) under a project
Test live connectivity against supplied database connection credentials before saving

get.description: Get database connection metadata (sensitive credentials omitted)
Inspects the complete database schema including all tables, columns, constraints, and indexes
Returns a list of all table names available in the connected database
Returns full column metadata, data types, primary keys, and indexes for a specific table
Query paginated live data rows from a target database table

put.description: Update an existing row identified by its primary key

post.description: Insert a single record into a connected database table

delete.description: Delete a row identified by its primary key

post.description: Test live connectivity using a previously saved database connection

get.description: Returns all migration jobs for the specified project, ordered by creation date descending.
get.summary: List all migration jobs for a project

post.description: Starts an asynchronous migration from source to target database table. Returns the job ID immediately.

get.description: Returns the details and current status of a specific migration job.

delete.description: Cancels a running migration job. Only works for migrations in 'running' or 'pending' state.

get.description: Opens an SSE connection that streams real-time progress events for a running migration.

post.description: Calculates structural differences (added tables, deleted tables, altered columns) between two database connections

get.description: Returns all registered webhooks for an organization.

post.description: Subscribes an endpoint URL to organization events. Secret is returned only upon creation.

get.description: Returns configuration details for a specific webhook.

put.description: Updates the name, URL, subscribed events, or active status of a webhook.

delete.description: Removes a webhook subscription and disables future event deliveries.

get.description: Returns recent HTTP delivery logs including payloads, HTTP status codes, and execution times.
get.summary: List recent delivery logs for a webhook

post.description: Dispatches a synthetic 'ping' event to the webhook URL and returns the HTTP status and latency.
post.summary: Send a test ping event to webhook endpoint

get.description: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user
get.summary: Get currently logged in user profile

put.description: Update the first and last name of the user

get.description: Checks whether a specific username is already taken
get.summary: Check if a username is available

post.description: Allows the user to set their username once. Cannot be updated.
